question: Lakshya Sen is associated with which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Badminton__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Lakshya Sen,** born in Almora on 16 August 2001 is an Indian badminton player**.
 
• He belongs to a badminton family, His brother;** Chirag Sen, is also an international badminton player.**
 
• **His father D. K. Sen, is a coach in India.**
